findings.detail: validate_html_capture implements the required period-shape check re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}(-\d{2}-\d{2})?', ...) -> invalid_period, but parse_html_identity only ever emits None, 'YYYY' or 'YYYY-MM-DD' (invalid months/days are range-rejected and yield no period, e.g. '2025-13-01' -> None). invalid_period can therefore only fire if a caller mutates the identity dict. This is a defensive check as specified in C2; matches the acceptance criteria and is not a defect.
findings.title: invalid_period verdict is unreachable from parse_html_identity output alone

findings.detail: _extract_period searches the CN 'YYYY年M月D日' pattern before the ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' pattern regardless of text position, so a page containing both returns the CN-formatted date. The acceptance criterion does not define cross-format precedence; the implementation docstring says 'first CN/ISO date'. Behavior is deterministic and consistent; not a violation of C1.
findings.title: CN date takes precedence over ISO date when both appear on a page
